item.title: Show HN: ABC Classic 100 Rankings visualised
item.description:
📝 ABC Classic 100 Rankings: 2001 to 2021 Every year since 2001, ABC Classic FM has run a Classic 100 event, where listeners vote on their favourite pieces. This page visualises the rankings for three different years: The Original Classic 100 from 2001, Classic 100 10 Years on from 2010, and Music you can't live without from 2021 Each dot represents a piece of music. The lines track how the rankings for that piece have changed between 2001 and 2021.
🔗 Read more: https://classic100.gotski.workers.dev/

item.title: Aging and Eye Problems
item.description:
